page_title: NAN 2-0 MNT | Nantes v Montpellier 22/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Marc Bollengier has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+1' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marc Bollengier had an easy-decision to make.

90+1' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Alban Lafont shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' A substitution has been made. Quentin Merlin goes off and Jaouen Hadjam (Nantes) comes on.
88' A quickly taken corner by Nantes.

88' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Quentin Merlin (Nantes) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nantes.
79' The referee allows time for a substitution. Marcus Coco will be replaced by Ronael Pierre-Gabriel (Nantes).
78' Substitution. Leo Leroy (Montpellier) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Teji Savanier walks off.
78' Here is a change. Jordan Ferri is going off and Michel Der Zakarian gives the last tactical orders to Yanis Issoufou (Montpellier).
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Theo Sainte-Luce (Montpellier) will replace Issiaga Sylla.
75' Kader Bamba (Nantes) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
74' 2 - 0 Goal! Moses Simon tees up Kader Bamba (Nantes) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 2:0.
73' Kader Bamba (Nantes) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
68' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
68' The resulting set piece from Montpellier is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
67' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
65' Montpellier can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
64' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Florent Mollet (Nantes) was quite harsh and Marc Bollengier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
63' Nantes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
61' Adson (Nantes) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
58' Michel Der Zakarian prepares a substitution. Akor Adams is replaced by Kelvin Yeboah (Montpellier).
58' Substitution. Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) in, Wahbi Khazri out.
58' Pierre Aristouy has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kader Bamba (Nantes) replacing Moussa Sissoko.
57' Here comes a substitution. Matthis Abline is given a rest as he is replaced by Adson (Nantes).
56' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

54' Akor Adams (Montpellier) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Alban Lafont, who pulls off a comfortable save!

51' What a big chance! Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
49' A pass into the penalty area from Moses Simon (Nantes) is intercepted by the defence.

49' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Nantes are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
47' Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball. Montpellier are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Marc Bollengier saw the whole situation. Nantes have been awarded a free kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 0 Goal! Florent Mollet (Nantes) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Benjamin Lecomte and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 1:0.

41' Moses Simon (Nantes) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball is behind the touchline and Nantes will take a throw-in.
40' Moses Simon (Nantes) commits a foul during an attacking move. It's a free kick to Montpellier in a dangerous position.
36' The corner is swung in but Nantes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

35' Moses Simon (Nantes) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Nantes will have a chance to score from a corner.
35' Moses Simon (Nantes) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

32' Fine play by Quentin Merlin (Nantes) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
29' Marc Bollengier couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Joris Chotard (Montpellier) and blew his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Nantes.
27' Florent Mollet (Nantes) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Montpellier.
27' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Nantes.
25' Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Montpellier will have a goal kick.
24' The ball is cleared after Moses Simon (Nantes) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Nantes.
22' The Montpellier players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
20' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

16' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Alban Lafont, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
14' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
10' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
9' The game is interrupted now, Teji Savanier (Montpellier) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
9' Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. It's a free kick to Montpellier, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.

8' What a chance that is! Eray Comert (Nantes) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the left post!
8' Moses Simon (Nantes) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
7' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Montpellier, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
6' Marc Bollengier has a clear sight and sees a foul from Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes). Montpellier win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
5' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
4' Montpellier are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.

1' Matthis Abline (Nantes) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his strike towards the bottom right corner as Benjamin Lecomte produces a good save.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Nantes will have the kick-off.
Marc Bollengier is introduced as the referee for today's match.
